segments.text:
The procedure has four steps.

1. Record the ambient temperature before opening the case.
2. Remove the drum and set it aside on a dry surface.
3. Inspect the pen arm for play at the hinge.
4. Reassemble, then wait a full hour before reading the trace.

Skipping the final step is the most common error. Others include:

- opening the case in direct sun
- handling the drum without gloves
- recording the time from memory
